what: Lifeline armed on the real SluiceReactive on Reactive Lasna (2026-11-23), after SluiceReactive ran out of lREACT during a 100-loop Flow B run and was blacklisted by the network.
worstCase: At most 0.9 lREACT can ever be spent on this contract by Lifeline, 0.5 per rescue and no more than one rescue per 60 seconds.
status: Armed, not yet triggered on SluiceReactive. The same mechanism was exercised live on a probe contract (results/lifeline-probe.json); it has not been shown on this contract because doing so means letting it run into debt on purpose.
note: The earlier outage was fixed by hand: 6.5 lREACT was sent to the system contract's depositTo for SluiceReactive, which paid its 0.0121 lREACT debt and the network emitted WhitelistContract (tx 0x02f130979f57cdef6ca5dfdee861aed53b0ba8bc090904d54afd38186070de4a).
